set system host-name r1
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.0.1.1/30
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-0/0/0
set routing-options router-id 10.0.1.1

set system host-name r2
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.0.2.1/30
set protocols bgp group external type external
set routing-options router-id 10.0.2.1

set system host-name r3
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.0.3.1/30
set policy-options policy-statement EXPORT term ACCEPT then accept
set routing-options router-id 10.0.3.1

set system host-name r4
set interfaces lo0 unit 0 family inet address 10.0.4.1/32
set protocols isis interface ge-0/0/0
set routing-options router-id 10.0.4.1

set system host-name r5
set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.0.5.1/30
set protocols ospf area 0.0.0.0 interface ge-0/0/0
set routing-options router-id 10.0.5.1
